name: Bench Dips
how_to:
1. Set Up Your Position
  - Sit on the edge of a sturdy bench or elevated surface.
  - Place your hands next to your hips, gripping the bench with fingers pointing forward.
2. Position Your Feet
  - Place your legs on a high bench.
  - Keep your knees bent at 90 degrees with feet flat on the floor for an easier version.
3. Execution
  - Slide your hips off the bench, supporting your weight with your arms.
  - Lower your body by bending your elbows until they form a 90-degree angle.
  - Keep your elbows close to your torso and maintain control throughout the movement.
  - Press through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
4. Repeat
  - Perform the desired number of repetitions while maintaining proper form.
